configurePresets.name: native-base
configurePresets.description: Native host build (Linux GCC/Clang or Windows MSVC). x86_64-native.cmake dispatches on the host to x86_64-linux.cmake or x86_64-windows-msvc.cmake, so one preset name still works on every CI runner — and, unlike before, those files actually apply: naming no toolchain file at all kept the presets portable by making both host files dead weight. Neither may set CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME, which would flip CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING even on a matching host and trip the root CMakeLists guards on FMU/SIM/EXAMPLES builds.

configurePresets.name: renode-h743
configurePresets.description: Firmware cross-compiled for the Nucleo-H743 BSP, run under Renode SWIL or flashed HWIL

configurePresets.name: cross-stm32f446
configurePresets.description: Firmware cross-compiled for the custom STM32F446 ECS gateway BSP. Build only — see tests/README.md CI matrix.

configurePresets.name: fmu-native
configurePresets.description: Builds every module as an x86 FMI 2.0 and FMI 3.0 co-simulation FMU for Aetherion co-simulation

configurePresets.name: examples-native
configurePresets.description: fmu-native plus the host-side end-to-end examples (Ecos co-simulation of Aetherion + Hemerion FMUs)

configurePresets.name: test-native
configurePresets.description: Native host build with module test binaries. Sanitizers and coverage are opt-in, not automatic: pass -DHEMERION_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON (cmake/sanitizers.cmake) or -DHEMERION_ENABLE_COVERAGE=ON (cmake/coverage.cmake), which is what the sanitizers and coverage workflows do.

configurePresets.name: test-swil
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiled STM32H743 firmware plus the tests/swil pytest harness, run under Renode via pyrenode3

testPresets.name: fmu-native
testPresets.description: Verifies every packaged .fmu archive's layout. The label is carried by the tests generateFMU() registers per archive, so 'no tests matched' means the FMU build stopped producing them -- hence noTestsAction error, not ignore: with ignore this preset passed while running nothing at all.
